raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
In case of no-FSDP parameters include some preparation ops, that must be done only once.
E.g. quantization, casts.

We do not want to repeat them in every microbatch and extract them with  FSDP all-gather chains into UNSHARD action.

Previously we did not run this extraction for FSDP1 case which resulted in duplication of quantization in every microbatch action. 

This PR enables this extraction for PP and no FSDP.

detail.body:
In case of no-FSDP parameters include some preparation ops, that must be done only once.
E.g. quantization, casts.

We do not want to repeat them in every microbatch and extract them with  FSDP all-gather chains into UNSHARD action.

Previously we did not run this extraction for FSDP1 case which resulted in duplication of quantization in every microbatch action. 

This PR enables this extraction for PP and no FSDP.

files.patch:
@@ -207,8 +207,17 @@ def _find_fsdp_unshard_outputs(
             continue
         last_all_gather = _find_last_all_gather_in_chain(user)
         if last_all_gather is None:
-            continue
-        output = _unshard_output_from_all_gather(last_all_gather)
+            if user.meta.get("autograd_backward", False) or not fsdp_param_fqns(user):
+                continue
+            # FSDP1 will not have all-gather, but we want to extract cast and quantization
+            # chains to do them once during unshard.
+            output = _find_last_non_view_node_in_chain(
+                _find_last_user_in_wait_chain(user)
+            )
+            if output is param_placeholder:
+                continue
+        else:
+            output = _unshard_output_from_all_gather(last_all_gather)
         if output not in seen:
             seen.add(output)
             outputs.append(output)

 class GraphExecutionPlan:
     """Resolved FSDP placement, gradient accumulation, and action variants.
 
-    ``unshard`` and ``reduce_grad`` are ``None`` without FSDP. With FSDP:
+    ``reduce_grad`` is ``None`` without FSDP.
+    In case of PP and no FSDP parameters preparation (e.g. cast, quantization) are
+    also extracted into unshard to do it only once.
+
+    With FSDP:
 
     - SPMD without gradient accumulation keeps both boundaries in its single
       joint graph.

     accumulation. SPMD without gradient accumulation keeps both boundaries in
     the joint graph, and PP extracts both into the schedule.
     """
+    if pp_enabled:
+        # For FSDP1 fsdp_enabled=False, but we do extraction of common params preparation,

     if not fsdp_enabled:
         return None, None
-    if pp_enabled:

     if num_microbatches == 1:

@@ -2319,6 +2319,53 @@ def test_joint_unshard_and_reduce_grad_extractions_compose(self) -> None:
         actual = (compute_outputs[0], *reduced_grads)
         _assert_tensor_sequence_equal(self, actual, expected)
 
+    def test_forward_split_extracts_local_parameter_preparation(self) -> None:
+        gm = _make_forward_graph_with_quantized_unshard()
+        graph = gm.graph
+        param = graph.find_nodes(op="placeholder")[0]
+        (all_gather,) = graph.find_nodes(
+            op="call_function",
+            target=torch.ops._c10d_functional.all_gather_into_tensor.default,
+        )
+        (wait,) = graph.find_nodes(
+            op="call_function", target=torch.ops._c10d_functional.wait_tensor.default
+        )
+        with graph.inserting_before(all_gather):
+            cast = graph.call_function(
+                torch.ops.aten._to_copy.default,
+                args=(param,),
+                kwargs={"dtype": torch.bfloat16},
+            )
+        cast.meta.update(all_gather.meta)
+        wait.replace_all_uses_with(cast)
+        graph.erase_node(wait)
+        graph.erase_node(all_gather)
+        graph.lint()
+        gm.recompile()
+        deduplicate_fsdp_unshard_chains_pass(gm)
+
+        split = extract_fsdp_unshard_graph(
+            gm,
+            num_params=1,
+            input_names=("sharded_param", "x"),
+            flat_input_indices=(0, 1),
+        )
+        self.assertIsNotNone(split.unshard_module)
+        for target in (
+            torch.ops.aten._to_copy.default,
+            _quantize_weight_for_graph_test,
+        ):
+            self.assertIn(target, _call_targets(split.unshard_module))
+            self.assertNotIn(target, _call_targets(split.compute_module))
+
+        weight = torch.arange(4, dtype=torch.float32) / 7
+        prepared = split.unshard_module(weight)
+        for microbatch in range(240):
+            x = torch.full((4,), microbatch, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+            expected = gm(weight, x)
+            actual = split.compute_module(*prepared, x)
+            _assert_tensor_sequence_equal(self, actual, expected)
+
     def test_forward_split_keeps_quantization_in_unshard_chain(self) -> None:
         gm = _make_forward_graph_with_quantized_unshard()
         deduplicate_fsdp_unshard_chains_pass(gm)
